items.question: What types of engagements does IP3 undertake?
items.answer: IP3 undertakes diagnostics, policy and program design, project preparation, implementation support, evaluations, convening processes, and research partnerships. We work as prime consultant or subconsultant depending on the mandate.

items.question: Does IP3 work as prime consultant or subconsultant?
items.answer: Both. We serve as prime consultant on assignments where our capabilities are the core requirement, and as subconsultant or specialist partner on larger multi-firm engagements where our sector or technical expertise adds specific value.

items.question: What is IP3's approach to quality assurance and fiduciary compliance?
items.answer: All deliverables undergo internal peer review and senior technical review. We are familiar with fiduciary and safeguard requirements of World Bank, ADB, AfDB, EU, and bilateral donors, and design our work to meet these standards.

items.question: Can IP3 provide verified references?
items.answer: Yes. Verified references from previous clients are available on request, subject to confidentiality agreements where applicable.

items.question: How quickly can IP3 mobilize a team?
items.answer: For urgent assignments, we can typically mobilize a core team within 5–10 business days, depending on scope and specialist requirements.

items.question: How does IP3 handle confidentiality and NDAs?
items.answer: We routinely work under NDA and are experienced with confidential assignments. All team members are bound by confidentiality obligations, and we can execute client-specific NDAs prior to proposal submission.
